# Build: fix-refreshing-console-jumps-back

## Brett said (verbatim)
At: 2026-11-17T21:36:54.206Z
> when are we fixing the refresh bug

## What to build
Continue build "Fix: refreshing the console jumps back instead of staying put" (fix-refreshing-console-jumps-back) — Phase 1, model Opus.
What Brett asked for (build-origin@1, his words come first; a paraphrase never replaces them):
Brett said (2026-11-17 21:36):
"when are we fixing the refresh bug"
Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.
Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 10 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.
Checkpoints: Steps are checkpoints inside this ONE session, not separate tasks: work through them in order without stopping between them; when a step is finished, commit it on your branch, push, then tick it done before starting the next. Nothing is lost if the session dies: the next session picks up at the first open step on the same branch. Never ask for a new prompt or a relaunch per step.
Look: UI code (handwritten or generated) conforms to the hot-swappable asset system: every colour, size, spacing, font, radius and border comes from asset tokens (--fx-* colour/style, --fx-type-* / --fx-dens-* / --fx-size-* scale, --fx-radius-*, --fx-border-w; Kotlin: Axf.colors / Axf.type / Axf.space / Axf.shapes), framework controls instead of raw ones, no var() fallbacks. `node framework/cli/check-theme.mjs` and `check-controls.mjs` must pass (CI fails otherwise); `node framework/cli/scale-adopt.mjs <path>` moves most literals onto the tokens.
API: Everything comes with an API (Brett, Nov 8 2026): anything this build adds or changes that has a UI gets full API control: a deep link that opens it (console_show / console_open target), its state readable, and every action and setting it offers callable without the UI, through the console API (REST), MCP tools (console actions, plugin commands, control@1 for tokens and planner items), the CLI and voice (AmberX), all four the same. A UI-only feature is not done; say in the PR how each one is reached.
Branch: claude/fix-refreshing-console-jumps-back · PR #825
Steps in this phase (1 left, ~15 min):
[x] s1 (~10 min) Reproduce and find the cause: trace how the console restores its place on load (view/route state in apps/console-web/src, URL hash/query, sessionStorage/localStorage keys, console.refresh handler, service worker/hot reload, pull-to-refresh). Write findings (which state is lost: view, tab, scroll, selection; and the scroll-lock cause after an update) to _claude/builds/reports/fix-refreshing-console-jumps-back.md as a draft
[x] s2 (~10 min) Check the scroll lock after an update: find what leaves body/root overflow hidden or a scrim/pointer-events overlay after an update or refresh banner (update toast, dialog close, pull-to-refresh handler, overscroll-behavior) and note the exact file:line in the draft report
[x] s3 (~10 min) Add a console place store: one small module (apps/console-web/src/place/placeState.ts) that saves the current view address, active tab per tab group, selection and scroll offsets of the main scroller and named panes to sessionStorage (debounced, on pagehide/visibilitychange too), keyed by console-control addresses (view:/tab:/row:)
[x] s4 (~10 min) Restore view + tab on load: wire the place store into the console's router/app shell so a reload reopens the saved view and tabs before the first paint, and URL deep links still win over the saved place
[x] s5 (~10 min) Restore scroll + selection: after the restored view mounts and its data loads, reapply scroll offsets (retry until content is tall enough, give up after a short timeout) and the selected row/item; stop any default scroll-to-top or default-tab reset that fires after load
[x] s6 (~10 min) Server-pushed console.refresh keeps the place: make the refresh handler (soft and --hard) save the place right before reloading and the soft refresh re-render without resetting view/tab/scroll
[x] s7 (~8 min) Pull-down refresh keeps the place: make the pull-to-refresh path save and restore the same state as reload, and leave scroll unlocked when it finishes
[x] s8 (~10 min) Fix the scroll lock after an update: clear any leftover overflow/pointer-events lock or stale overlay when the update/refresh flow ends (and on load as a safety net), using the cause found in step 2
[x] s9 (~10 min) API part: expose the saved place read-only and the restore action through the console API, keeping all four drivers the same: REST GET/POST /api/console-control place (read state, restore), MCP console tool, axf console place [get|restore], and an AmberX voice action; register targets with control@1 (append-only)
[x] s10 (~10 min) Tests: a unit test for placeState save/restore/deep-link precedence and a Playwright check against vite preview: open a tab deep in a view, scroll, select a row, reload, pull-refresh and server-push refresh; assert the same place is restored and the page still scrolls
[x] s11 (~10 min) Run the checks (typecheck, check-theme, check-controls, check-console-control, check-toolbars), finish the report _claude/builds/reports/fix-refreshing-console-jumps-back.md (cause, fix, before/after), update the THREADS row and open the PR naming how each part is reached (REST, MCP, CLI, voice)
[ ] s12 (~15 min) Land this build (watchdog, attempt 1: fresh-session). It stood still with its PR open (landing for 4 days: PR #825 is still open and nothing moved it). Start from `git status`, `git log origin/main..HEAD` and the tail of the last run log; do not repeat what the earlier session did. Merge origin/main into claude/fix-refreshing-console-jumps-back, get every check green and push; the PR is #825.
Tick each step right after its commit: node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs act step fix-refreshing-console-jumps-back <stepId> done — it reaches main at once (builds-live). Link your branch / PR: node framework/cli/builds-live.mjs link fix-refreshing-console-jumps-back --branch <b> --pr <n>.
Watch live: when you start on a screen, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "…"` so the live preview follows you.
Screenshots that are not for approval (checking a screen, live captures, before/after): axf shot <file> --name "…" --app … --screen … --group "<build name>" (UI Review → Screenshots; ui-review-item@1), never the review queue.
